v1.name: V1 readiness
v1.status: Supervised pilot: premium Fargate skill build unproven; production phone dashboard usability gap open
v1.summary: Nov 1 snapshot of production web :442 and worker :283 confirms AWS website transport, smart onboarding enabled, print orders enabled in sandbox. The premium skill integration remains behind unfinished open Stromation #333, businessbuilder #920 and skill #1; picture library or image-approval proof is absent. A live premium-on phone audit documented unusable dashboard touch/input behavior (#915 open). Staging detected a backend import crash, fixed in merged #919; current businessbuilder main 93add7eb is CodeBuild-green, not independently established as deployed. No three accepted premium site handoffs, unattended recovery or timed restore proof.

v2.name: V2 readiness
v2.status: Five standard workers and integrations exist; repeated live-provider operating outcomes unverified
v2.summary: Nov 1 captured production switches enable several workforce and integration routes, daily recap, smart onboarding and guarded chat. A live operator workflow with repeated useful outcomes from all five workers, provider-backed actions, delivered recaps and unattended recovery still has not been demonstrated. Print orders are sandbox, not real revenue proof.

v3.name: V3 / Full 10/10 vision
v3.status: Better live onboarding, but phone UX regression; premium build, SaaS/custom agents and economics unproven
v3.summary: Businessbuilder live snapshot now confirms smart onboarding and sandbox print orders, with an offline smart-onboarding holdout score reported at 95.7% in #895; no accepted production onboarding proof. Premium-on mobile dashboard has evidenced usability defects (#915 open). Fargate skill browser wiring and image sourcing remain incomplete, with no accepted delivery. Full SaaS, automated custom agents, 95-99% routine autonomy and 1-2 founder technical hours weekly remain unproven.

autonomyProof.note: Representative success/attempt denominator is still unavailable; do not imply the 95–99% V3 mature target has been measured.

founderWorkload.note: Darius minutes are not comprehensively separated from operator effort, customer approvals or specialist review.

biggestChange: Production snapshot now shows smart onboarding and sandbox print orders enabled, but live phone testing found a material premium dashboard usability problem (#915 open) while Fargate skill wiring remains open.
improvements: Nov 1 redacted live ECS snapshot (#921) records web :442 / worker :283, AWS website backend, smart onboarding enabled and print ordering enabled in sandbox; live functionality itself was not re-run.
Smart onboarding #895 merged; PR reports 95.7% on 14 holdout inputs (offline), but no full real owner intake proof.
Staging release B rejected an import crash; #919 merged a fix before later recorded production revision. Businessbuilder main 93add7eb CodeBuild status success.
Dashboard fact-source fixes #910, marketing policy checks #906 and consent controls #905 merged; activation and live behavior differ by flag.
regressions: Founder reported premium-on dashboard unusable on a phone Oct 31; #915 documents 13px inputs causing iOS zoom, small touch areas and mobile sheets in main, with the fix still open.
Prior production web :440 mobile review found about 160 controls under 44px per iPhone pass, not all resolved in the captured production release.

Stromation main 01fbcd79 has #331 premium skill code but it remains default-off; PRs Stromation #332/#333 and builder #920 are open.
Brand Studio all-plan print catalog #913 merged behind new default-off PRINT_PIECES_ENABLED.
deployed: Nov 1 captured ECS flags (source #921) web :442 / worker :283: WEBSITE_BUILDER_BACKEND=aws, SMART_ONBOARDING_ENABLED=true on web/API, PRINT_ORDERS_ENABLED=true on API with sandbox-mode reported.
DASHBOARD_PREMIUM_ENABLED=true on web/API; website content edits and visual editor flags false. No evidence the premium Fargate skill is enabled.
verified: Businessbuilder main 93add7eb CodeBuild success and Stromation main 01fbcd79 CodeBuild success; statuses establish CI, not live customer acceptance.
PR #915 reports real-phone and browser observations of premium dashboard flaws; repair remains open and no post-fix release proved.
PR #919 documents staging import failure caught before promotion; subsequent redacted production revision recorded, not independent live health proof.
No accepted full premium skill delivery, three handed-off websites, repeat unattended recovery, representative settled margins or measured founder hours.

promisesOverreach: Do not count open #915/#920, Stromation #332/#333 or skill #1 as implemented or deployed.
Do not equate enabled smart-onboarding flags and offline holdout results with a production-verified customer intake.
PRINT_ORDERS_ENABLED=true is sandbox only; PRINT_PIECES_ENABLED remains off and neither counts as live sales.
Do not claim Fargate website skill images are solved: image library/approval contract still missing.
Do not claim the premium phone dashboard is launch-ready or that five workers, SaaS/custom agents and V3 economics are proven.
founderWorkloadTrend: No measured founder technical workload; normal owner approvals, account setup and specialist reviews are explicitly excluded.
nextActions: Finish T1 Fargate browser and skill-host wiring (#1/#333/#920), add real picture sourcing/approval, then run one approved premium AWS build and reconcile cost.
Repair and browser-verify phone dashboard #915, then complete three distinct paid-to-published site handoffs with revisions and ownership.
Prove unattended crash recovery, payment/auth/form flows, deployment overlap and timed restore on the release actually offered to customers.

assumptions: The website-builder asset/recovery defect is fixed and the merged repair release is deployed and repeatedly proven within roughly 30 days.
SelfOperate receives about 150–500 qualified prospects/visitors over 90 days.
Paid conversion is roughly 1–2% while the product remains supervised.
Supervised delivery capacity remains roughly 2–4 projects per month.
Roughly half to three-quarters of eligible delivered customers retain the $299/month ongoing SelfOperate service after any included period.
